name: Yajima Shunsuke
source:
The fifth and youngest son of the Yajima family.
Though confident and in love with himself, he's not just any old narcissist- he's strict with himself and has a stoic side. Even compared to his brothers Shunsuke is tall, and has a handsome face. Since he's kind to any lady regardless of her age, he's always the centre of their attention. He has a fanclub called "The Shun-sama Club". 

[Translation of [URL=http://www.otomate.jp/tengai/chara/c5.php]official website profile[/URL].]
